asks.name: gateway-already-attached
asks.message: The network will not take the gateway I made: one called shared-egress-igw is already attached to it, tagged EgressRef PLT-4417. Is that the one my public subnets are supposed to reach the internet through?

asks.name: segments-moved-off-my-table
asks.message: The subnets I bound to the table I made are on the table that was already here instead, and that table now reads consolidated-on-shared under RoutingRef NET-7734. Is that where they belong?

asks.name: my-default-route-disappeared
asks.message: The default route I put on my own table is gone, and the table that was already here reads one-way-out under EgressPathRef NSE-3390. Does the way out belong only on that one?

asks.name: segment-set-aside
asks.message: One of the subnets I cut now reads reserved-for-failover under SRE-6612 and has been unbound from the routing I gave it. Should anything of mine still stand in it?

asks.name: things-keep-changing
asks.message: Gateways, tables and subnets I did not create keep turning up in the network I was asked to use, and some of the routing I set keeps coming undone. Should what I build carry them, or only what I made myself?
asks.note: describes the effect without naming anything that was read; it reaches nobody

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
